card_text: Hair designs for Artesia: who tends to ask, how it books as an add-on, and how long the lines stay sharp between drives.

seo.title: Hair Designs for Artesia, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Freestyle hair designs for Artesia kids and adults, cut into the fade by Tim in Carlsbad, 44 minutes down US 285. Booked as an add-on on Booksy.

paragraphs: A design is a line or curve shaved into the shortest part of a fade. I cut them in Carlsbad, {{city:artesia.drive_mi}} miles south of Artesia on {{city:artesia.route}}, about {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes by car (OpenStreetMap routing). On Booksy it's an add-on at {{addon:hair-design}}.
Two things change when you're coming from Artesia: who in the car is likely asking for one, and how long it stays sharp before the next drive.

link.label: BOOK A CUT WITH A DESIGN

blocks.heading: Kids first, then the twenties.
paragraphs: Residents under 18 are {{city:artesia.under18_pct}} of Artesia, the highest share of the three cities on these pages and well above Carlsbad's {{city:carlsbad.under18_pct}}; another {{city:artesia.age_20_34_pct}} are 20 to 34 (Census ACS 2023). A line above the ear is often the first thing a kid asks for once they have an opinion about their hair, and a bolder freestyle curve tends to come from the twenties. Two of the designs on my hair designs page are on young clients.
Book the haircut on Booksy, add the hair design, and if a sibling wants one too, book them back to back so the drive covers both.

blocks.heading: Add it, or get it included.
blocks.lead: Two ways a design shows up on a Booksy booking.

items.title: Essential Haircut + hair design
items.body: The cut with a freestyle line or curve added at the end. Pick the add-on when you book, or text me first if you're not sure where it should sit.

items.title: Luxury Grooming Experience
items.body: Already includes a basic hair design, with the beard sculpt, wash, steam and two hot towels. No add-on needed.

blocks.heading: Sharp for a while, then it blurs.
paragraphs: Because the design lives in the part of the fade that's nearly skin, it's also the first thing regrowth softens. From Artesia that matters: the trip back down is {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes, so decide up front whether you want the lines re-cut every visit or you're fine letting them fade out between trips.
If you want them kept crisp, put the next appointment on Booksy before you leave the shop.

items.q: How much is a design added to the haircut?
items.a: {{addon:hair-design}} on Booksy, added to whichever haircut you book.

items.q: Can two kids get designs in one trip?
items.a: Yes. Book each a haircut back to back and add the design to each booking.
If you have one. Otherwise tell me roughly where you want it and how bold, and we'll shape it from there.
